Dear Reza,
Thank you for contacting our eMobility Support.
Based on the new information provided, and after reviewing the issue you reported, we confirm that it was related to an OCPP connection dropping.
Unfortunately, this stems from your Ethernet connection; so, it’s beyond our control. We recommend contacting your Internet provider to ensure a more stable connection.
Best regards,
Ivan
Siemens eMobility Technical Support Team

additional_info.subject: AW: ID0471413-DC/Si-D/SE-[MP/S4170003556] Field issues with your charging station CRM:03056000919
additional_info.body:
Dear Ivan,
Does this mean that the problem is not with the vehicle but with the charging station's internet connection or communication with the backend? And that leads to a communication interruption and ultimately the charging process being cancelled.
Best regards,
Reza Hosseini
Mit freundlichen Grüßen / Cordialement / Best regards
Reza Hosseini
M.Sc.
Testingenieur Automotive Ladesysteme (EAHL/8)

additional_info.subject: ID0471413-DC/Si-D/SE-[MP/S4170003556] Field issues with your charging station CRM:03056000919
additional_info.body:
Dear Reza,
Thank you for contacting our eMobility Support.
Correct. The root cause is the local network connection, not the vehicle. When the Ethernet connection drops, the station cannot communicate with the backend system. Consequently, the lack of communication leads to the charging process being cancelled.
For this reason,
w
e recommend contacting your Internet provider to ensure a more stable connection.
Best regards,
Ivan
Siemens eMobility Technical Support Team

Dear
Reza Hosseini
I would like to inform you that your support case
0471413
has been resolved.
Here is a summary of the actions taken:
The root cause is the local network connection, not the vehicle. When the Ethernet connection drops, the station cannot communicate with the backend system. Consequently, the lack of communication leads to the charging process being cancelled.
Since the reported issue has been resolved, I will proceed to close this case.
Thank you for your cooperation, and please don’t hesitate to reach out through our support form for any future requests:
